summary: ITER453 + ITER452.5.2 frontend-only certification of QaqcLifecyclePanel and SiteInspectionLifecyclePanel on their host pages /admin/qaqc/{id} and /admin/inspections/{id}. Logged in as super-admin (jaymn.judd@mascigc.com) via /sign-in, walked the two seed records through OPEN -> DEFICIENCY_RAISED/FINDINGS_RAISED -> IN_REMEDIATION -> PENDING_RE_INSPECTION via API to expose all four panel surfaces (state pill, role-gated CLOSE button, REWORK button, History), then exercised the closure modal's three operational-evidence paths, the reason modal, and the history modal. All 13 UI assertions PASS for both panels; host pages still render normally with no console errors after panel injection.
critical_code_review_comments: Both panels are self-contained (no dependency on the generic LifecyclePanel) and correctly express the QA/QC + Site closure contract (text inputs for record id, notes, dual sign-off) that the generic checkbox-only closureConfig cannot.

Closure-modal validation gating is enforced client-side exactly per the state-machine contract: re_inspection requires non-empty record id; corrective_action requires notes >= 20 chars; exception requires reason >= 10 chars AND distinct PM and Safety user ids. Verified live in both panels.
Reason modal correctly disables confirm until >= 5 chars in both panels.
History modal correctly loads /state-events list (3 rows after API-driven transitions) and renders empty-state when none exist.
All interactive elements use stable data-testid attributes matching the contract from the review request, which makes the panels fully regression-testable.

Suggestion (non-blocking): Clearing the closure modal's evidence inputs when the user switches between the 3 radio paths would prevent stale-state confusion when the user toggles back to a previously filled path; currently the inputs persist across path switches. Behaviour is correct but minor UX nit.
test_credentials: jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123! (super_admin) via /sign-in -> multi-login; admin token surfaces in localStorage key masci.admin.token and is auto-attached by /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js as X-Admin-Token.
seed_data_creation: No new records created. Used existing preview records QC-2026-00014 (qaqc id b472ec62-ece8-405d-9c70-78c8c24b057b) and INSP-2026-00079 (inspection id b7077762-2b46-4fb3-889b-9de2e4ba77c3). Both were transitioned via API into PENDING_RE_INSPECTION to expose the CLOSE / REWORK buttons. After testing, attempted cleanup left QAQC in DEFICIENCY_RAISED and Site in FINDINGS_RAISED (PENDING_RE_INSPECTION cannot go directly back to OPEN per the state machine - this is correct backend behaviour, not a bug). Records are not closed and remain fully usable for the next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two screenshots saved to /app/test_reports/playwright/qaqc_panel.png and /app/test_reports/playwright/site_inspection_panel.png show the rendered panels with state pill = 'Pending Re-Inspection', both action buttons visible, and host content (QC-2026-00014 details / INSP-2026-00079 grade banner + sections) still intact above/below the panel. Two seed records are now in non-OPEN states - if next iteration needs OPEN-state assertions, pick a different record from /api/qaqc-inspections and /api/inspections listings or create a fresh one.
